messages:
marie_cs: 09:15 — Hey team, Praxis Health (POC: Jordan) just uploaded a vendor security questionnaire and flagged encrypted-at-rest and DPA questions. Link: https://okta.app/praxis/q/12345. They want answers before pilot next Wed. :clock9:

devin_se: 09:18 — Can someone confirm hosting mode? It'll change the KMS answers. Is this going on Redwood Private or Hosted?

akash_security: 09:20 — Praxis has PHI, so recommended Private (VPC) or Dedicated with SOC2 controls. If Private, customer-managed KMS needed. See SOC2 scope doc: https://redwood.internal/soc2-scope

marie_cs: 09:22 — They're asking for: 1) Data flow diagram, 2) KMS key type & rotation, 3) Logging/audit access, 4) Backup encryption. I started a draft for data flow.

devin_se: 09:28 — Draft data flow (quick):
```
Client -> App (Praxis) -> Redwood Private (VPC) ingress -> Inference runtime on GPU nodes -> KV cache (encrypted) -> Logs -> S3 (encrypted)
KMS: AWS-KMS (customer CMK), rotation: 90d
``` 

legal_bot: 09:31 — Heads up: DPA clause ID 3.2 needs to list subprocessors. Please attach the subprocessors matrix. Template: https://redwood.docs/dpa-template

marie_cs: 09:35 — @devin_se can you upload a subprocessors list? I'll own the DPA fields. @akash_security can you validate the KMS wording? :pray:

devin_se: 09:41 — Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/files/praxis-subprocessors.xlsx

akash_security: 09:47 — KMS wording suggestion: "Customer-managed CMK in AWS KMS (alias/prx-cmk). Root key rotation enforced via AWS KMS schedule; minimal key access via IAM roles." Approve? :thumbsup:

marie_cs: 09:50 — Good. Also Praxis asked about SOC2 evidence for incident response. I linked our IR runbook and last tabletop summary. They might ask for dates.

customer_jordan: 09:58 — Thanks team. We need the completed questionnaire and DPA redline by next Tue COB. Can you confirm who will send the package? We prefer one consolidated email.

marie_cs: 10:02 — I'll compile final package and send with a short cover note. Plan: finish draft by Mon EOD, legal to review Mon morning. Tagging @sara_legal for the review. :email:

sara_legal: 10:15 — On it. I'll prioritize DPA redline Monday AM. Expect comments by 11:30am.

marie_cs: 10:17 — Quick risk note for CS board: onboarding timeline slips + renewal signal if PILOT delayed. I'll add to account health doc and flag for AM sync.

devin_se: 10:19 — If we need a stopgap, we can provide a scoped SOC2 evidence pack with redacted dates to unblock pilot. Suggest we prep that now.

marie_cs: 10:21 — Great idea. I'll put a checklist in the thread and attach links.

marie_cs: 10:22 — CHECKLIST:
- [ ] Data flow diagram (devin) — done
- [ ] Subprocessors list (devin) — done
- [ ] KMS wording (akash) — draft
- [ ] IR evidence (marie) — link added
- [ ] DPA redline (sara) — pending
- [ ] Send consolidated package (marie) — pending

marie_cs: 10:23 — Tagging @account-ops to note potential renewal risk. :rotating_light:

end_of_thread_bot: 10:30 — Thread archived to ticket #CS-4221 by bot.
